reason: the main run's bounds for types 4, 5 and 6 were computed on the seeds on which the body-geometry and type-6 crossing defects were found and the metric narrowed (results/E44_defects.json); fresh seeds give bounds that the defect search did not see

seeds.main_run: builder (44, type, batch), run (4400, type, batch), batches 0..n-1
seeds.fresh: builder (4410, type, batch), run (4411, type, batch), batches 0..n-1; roots never used before (E44 44 / 4400, fixtures 4498 / 4499, E47 = E44)

bound_rule: zero violations: 1 - 0.05^(1/n_eff); x > 0: Clopper-Pearson upper (unweighted); Bonferroni alpha 0.00417 over the 12 types

4.title: crossing and merging at a junction; four-way contention (tile granularity 1-4)

5.title: cyclic wait on a ring of single-lane segments (3 or 4 vehicles, bays of 2 slots)

6.title: landing closure: vehicle inside, filed route through, delay and wave-off

fresh_seeds.bound_weighted_note: Clopper-Pearson upper limit on the effective sample: n_eff = (sum w)^2 / sum w^2 = 4580.4; effective violation count x_eff = n_eff x (weight of the violating encounters / sum w) = 0.219, rounded up to 1; weighted point rate 4.78e-05. E44's rule (unweighted Clopper-Pearson on n_driven once x > 0) gives 'bound' above, which is below the zero-violation bound on n_eff and so not comparable with it

replay.deterministic_basis: two single-encounter replays with the batch's seeds agree with each other and with the stored batch row (violation flags, deadlock, finished)
replay.what_happened: a vehicle held at the zone boundary (it could not cross before the closure) kept its grant for a one-lane resource beyond the zone, and a vehicle inside the zone waited at that resource's stop line and was still inside when the zone closed (hold-and-wait between R5 and R3)
replay.variant: a vehicle requests a resource only when no hold point it cannot pass (a closed or closing landing zone) lies before that resource
replay.scope_note: only this one encounter of the 10,000 fresh type-6 encounters was rerun under the variant; nothing is claimed about the variant on the others (E44's own variant run used the main-run seeds)

request_rule_fresh_6.variant: a vehicle requests a resource only when no hold point it cannot pass (a closed or closing landing zone) lies before that resource
request_rule_fresh_6.seeds: the 10,000 fresh type-6 encounters of B-108: builder (4410, 6, batch), run (4411, 6, batch); the variant sets request_rule on the same specs (parts FV06_b*.csv.gz)
request_rule_fresh_6.bound_note: bounds as in bound_rule above (one-sided 95 %; Bonferroni alpha over the 12 types); the variant is exploratory (PREREG change 9) and outside the Bonferroni family, its Bonferroni bound is given only to sit beside the rules-as-written value
request_rule_fresh_6.random_fuzzer_note: encounters with a random fuzzer draw from the batch-shaped run stream, so where the variant changes what a vehicle does, the fuzzer's later draws differ too; paired differences there are not the same random history
